entities.name: Aven
entities.description: Sentient anthropomorphic bird people found on many planes, each with a distinct bird species.

entities.name: Kathari
entities.description: A race of scavenging vulture-people of Grixis whose religion, Skive, holds that only cleansed skeletons enter the afterlife.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The plane of the Kathari vulture-people and of necromancers.

entities.name: Outcriers
entities.description: Mystical Kathari shamans with black pupilless eyes feared by other kathari.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard whose proud aven are warriors and mages, with a royal family of falcon-like aven in Valeron.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane whose aven have human bodies with avian heads and wings.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: A plane whose owl-like birdfolk are called owlin.

entities.name: Owlin
entities.description: Owl-like birdfolk of Arcavios who emerged at the end of the Dawning Age and live in Hookiver.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The school that uses strixes and owls as its symbol and has many owlin students and faculty.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A non-native of Arcavios with an affinity for owls who collected some for her coterie.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: An animalistic plane where birdfolk are among the animalfolk and Calamity Beasts include birds.

entities.name: Bloomburrow birdfolk
entities.description: Animalfolk of the Valley who carry mail and aid, follow the Wingbeat Way, and are allied with mousefolk.

entities.name: Maha, Its Feathers Night
entities.description: A titanic owl Calamity Beast that brings long nights.

entities.name: Pyreswipe Hawk
entities.description: A titanic hawk Calamity Beast that brings the sensation of summer.

entities.name: Falco Spara
entities.description: An aven who leads the Brokers on New Capenna.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: A New Capenna family that includes aven.

entities.name: Aesthir
entities.description: Giant birds used by the Kjeldorans of Dominaria's Ice Age as mounts for skyknights.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: A people of the Ice Age who rode aesthir.

entities.name: Oriel Kjeldos
entities.description: The first to train an aesthir.

entities.name: Marton Stromgald
entities.description: The first to use aesthir in combat against goblins.

entities.name: Parea
entities.description: Large flightless carnivorous birds of eastern Jamuraa.

entities.name: Primoc
entities.description: Bird and monkey-like hybrids created by the Riptide Project that serve wizards as familiars.

entities.name: Elen
entities.description: Hulking wingless avian humanoids serving as enforcers and infantry for the Order in Otaria.

entities.name: The Order
entities.description: The Otarian group served by elen, raypen and many aven.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The continent where aven used to be most prevalent.

entities.name: Karona War
entities.description: A cataclysmic war that displaced Otarian aven 250 years earlier.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact whose magic mutated Otarian aven and owl aven.

entities.name: Crookclaws
entities.description: Mutant owl aven enlarged and enhanced by the Mirari.

entities.name: Firefeathers
entities.description: A regiment of aven battlemages in New Argive led by Balmor.

entities.name: Balmor
entities.description: The aven wizard who leads the Firefeathers.

entities.name: Raypen
entities.description: Wingless avians who were scouts and magical support for the Order and backbone of Eagyn's forces.

entities.name: Eagyn
entities.description: A dragon whose forces were led by the raypen.

entities.name: Perchers
entities.description: Squid-like flying creatures that Phyrexians and Rathi used to relay messages.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian god whose hands may have corrupted Phyrexia's strange birds.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane whose four-limbed aven are associated with the clans.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: The Abzan Khan served by aven elite guards.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: The Jeskai Khan served by aven windscouts.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The dragonlord whose aven translators carry his voice.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: A dragonlord whose clan integrates aven into its family units.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragonlord allied with some vulture-like aven.

events.summary: The Karona War displaces Otarian aven, whose descendants settle New Argive and Benalia.
events.quote: The Aven of New Argive and Benalia are the descendants of refugees displaced by the cataclysmic Karona War

events.summary: The Mirari's magic mutates Otarian aven and owl aven into larger, taloned forms.
events.quote: As the Mirari 's magic washed across Otaria, altering its inhabitants, many aven became taller and more muscular

events.summary: The aesthir breed that could survive cold weather goes extinct after the Ice Age, but Kjeldorans breed a warm-weather variant.
events.quote: a breed that could survive warmer weather was bred by Kjeldorans and exists to the modern day.

events.summary: Oriel Kjeldos is the first to train an aesthir, and Marton Stromgald the first to use them in combat against goblins.
events.quote: It is said that Oriel Kjeldos was the first to train an Aesthir

events.summary: Around the Time Spiral crisis, Otarian aven are reduced to squatters in the continent's ruins.
events.quote: Around the time of the Time Spiral crisis, the aven were reduced to squatters in the continent's ruins.

events.summary: Parea follow Keldon war barges during the invasion of Jamuraa and are used to execute prisoners.
events.quote: were often found following the Keldon war barges looking for carrion

relations.note: a Calamity Beast bringing long nights to the animalfolk

relations.quote: led by the Aven wizard Balmor
